brazil_game.venue: Maracanã Stadium, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil (first NFL game in Rio); kickoff Sun Sept 27, 4:25 p.m. ET on CBS/Paramount+ (Jim Nantz, JJ Watt)
brazil_game.notes: NFL is proceeding at Maracanã despite field concerns: August rainfall was 208% above Aug 2025 and 46% of July/August soccer matches there were played in rain or within 24 hours of rain. NFL crews took over the surface Monday Sept 21; field director Nick Pappas says it will be ready and a tarp was shipped about a week earlier to protect it. Both teams travel Thursday Sept 24 and practice in Rio on Friday Sept 25 (short turnaround). Ravens HC Jesse Minter: 'no concerns' about the field. Cowboys HC Brian Schottenheimer noted the shorter week makes injured-player returns tougher.
brazil_game.expected_weather: No day-specific forecast found yet; seasonal expectation for Sept 27 is high ~81F / low ~69F, with September normally a low-rainfall month (~15 mm over ~5 days). Recent weeks were unusually wet, so a soft/patchy surface is the main risk rather than game-day weather.
